t: Designed for energy-demanding security equipment such as wireless IP cams, motion sensors and smoke detectors, as well as medical equipment such as AED kits. Delivers reliable operation between -40 to +60°C, with a shelf life of up to 10 years if stored in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Offers up to 15% more power capacity compared with CR2 batteries in IEC standard test (results subject to deviation with different usage behaviour and devices).
